limitations: Four-state closed model; reciprocal-area extinction and recipient-area rescue are assumptions; two reserves, fixed total area and minimum area; initial state both occupied; no empirical validation; full text of several closest reserve-design/lifetime publications inaccessible, leaving priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Exact four-state Markov first-step proof with independently formed transient generator and exact rational test; universal conclusions are analytic, not inferred from finite runs.
title: A sharp allocation switch for two habitat reserves under extinction and rescue
